# Upperbound

> Upperbound (upperboundrx.com) is a telehealth platform offering physician-guided
> 12-week health pathways in all 50 US states. A licensed physician reviews every
> intake within 24 hours. Payment is fully refunded if the physician does not
> approve a pathway. Nothing renews automatically.

## Pathways and pricing

- Weight Loss: built on GLP-1 class therapy, prescribed only if appropriate. $249/month on a 12-week arc, everything included.
- Recovery: built on sermorelin, prescribed only if appropriate. For training recovery, soreness turnaround, and sleep. $229/month on a 12-week arc.
- Output: built on NAD+, prescribed only if appropriate. For steady daily energy. $199/month on a 12-week arc.

All prices include the physician review, treatment if prescribed, shipping, and
check-ins at weeks 6 and 12. There are no add-on fees and no lab visits are
required to start.

## How it works

1. A short online quiz and eligibility questions (about a minute).
2. Purchase, then a medical intake reviewed personally by a licensed physician
   in the member's state within 24 hours.
3. If approved, the 12-week arc ships to the member's door with physician
   check-ins at week 6 and week 12. If not approved, the payment is refunded in
   full automatically.

## Key policies

- Available in all 50 US states through a national physician network.
- Refund in full if a physician does not approve the pathway.
- Billing ends at week 12; continuing requires an explicit member choice.
- Cancel any time in two clicks from the member dashboard.
- Not for emergencies. Emergencies: call 911.
